description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.t 01.12.2025 to 07.12.2025
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It formally announces and sets the official rates of exchange for various foreign currencies to be used for calculating customs duties and other charges. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the issuance of a statutory instrument, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized non-governmental categories.
